rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a medical doctor, without specifically contrasting internal medicine with surgery.

example.english: My son has a fever, so I’m taking him to see a physician.
example.traditional: 我個仔發燒，我帶佢去睇醫生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 faat3 siu1 ngo5 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a physician who treats medical conditions with medication rather than a surgeon.

example.english: This illness needs to be controlled with medication; you should see a physician in internal medicine, not a surgeon.
example.traditional: 呢個病要靠食藥控制，你應該去睇內科醫生，唔係外科醫生。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bing6 jiu3 kaau3 sik6 joek6 hung3 zai3 nei5 jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 noi6 fo1 ji1 sang1 m4 hai6 ngoi6 fo1 ji1 sang1
